feeds.title: Cleveland Scene
feeds.description: Welcome to the Cleveland Scene. It is a place where you will find information on various topics such as news, movies, music, food, arts, events, and much more. The Scene Magazine has served as the city's premiere, award-winning multimedia source of alternative news, events, and culture since 1970.

feeds.title: Cool Cleveland
feeds.description: Cool Cleveland keeps you in touch with cool events, people, news, and neighborhood in the Cleveland region. It aims to reveal to the world, the inherent coolness of Cleveland and the NEO region.

feeds.title: Cavs Nation | Cleveland Cavaliers Blog
feeds.description: Cavs Nation is your source for all your up-to-date Cleveland Cavaliers news and updates. It features anything from pre and post-game reports to potential rumors.

feeds.title: Glam Karen | Cleveland Fashion Blog
feeds.description: Want to know tricks on how to walk in heels? How to distress your own denim? What to wear booties with? What is the top trend? Where is the best online boutique to shop? The answers to all these questions will be found on Glam Karen.

feeds.title: Cleveland Sports Talk
feeds.description: At Cleveland Sports Talk Cavs, Browns, and Indians fans unite to talk about Cleveland Sports. Follow us to know more.

feeds.title: Northeast Ohio Parent
feeds.description: Northeast Ohio Parent is about Family Living at its Best. The magazine and its website are the go-to resources for active families in the region. Northeast Ohio Parent launched in March 2014 as a refreshing new monthly publication for parents in the Greater Cleveland/Akron region. The magazine and this website highlight the area's vast opportunities for families and the tremendous diversity of Cleveland and beyond.

feeds.title: Content Marketing World
feeds.description: Content Marketing World is the one event where you can learn and network with the best and the brightest in the content marketing industry. You will leave with all the materials you need to take a content marketing strategy back to your team and to implement a content marketing plan that will grow your business and inspire your audience.

feeds.title: Dawgs By Nature
feeds.description: Welcome to Dawgs By Nature. It is the best source for quality Cleveland Browns news, rumors, analysis, stats and scores from a fans perspective.

feeds.title: Fear The Sword
feeds.description: Get quality Cleveland Cavaliers news, rumors, analysis, stats and scores from the fan perspective.

feeds.title: The Cleveland Traveler Blog
feeds.description: A travel blog covering all the best things to see, do, and eat in Cleveland, Ohio.

feeds.title: Couponing with Rachel
feeds.description: Rachel is a stay-at-home mom to three boys in northeast Ohio. She has been 'couponing' for over 5 years and it has completely changed the way she shops. Rachel loves to not only find great local and national deals but she also likes to share them with others. She hopes that others will follow along with her on her money-saving journey. Go through the blog which will help you shop better during big shopping sales.

feeds.title: George Hahn
feeds.description: George Hahn is a writer, actor and self-made thousandaire in hot pursuit of sartorial stealth and effective living. This is a journal designed for men who weren't millionaires, but who also wanted to look good and live well.

feeds.title: Today's Bride Blog
feeds.description: Today's Bride stands as Northeast Ohio's premier wedding resource, committed to aiding engaged couples in realizing their dream weddings. Offering a free regional magazine, hosting bridal shows, and maintaining an online presence, they strive to simplify the wedding planning journey, earning trust as the region's most respected guide.

feeds.title: Natty Gal | Cultivating a simple, stylish and satisfying life!
feeds.description: Through Natty Gal, I hope to share with readers the tips and tricks I've learned for creating a simple, stylish and satisfying life. Addicted to personal development. Always on a quest to learn. Lover of new experiences. Enjoy fitness, cooking, great wines, outdoors, friendships, reading, athletic pursuits, entertaining, volunteering, homemaking. Proud to be from Northeast Ohio. Cherish my amazing, supportive husband and my loving Bichon Frise-Poodle mix Pucci!

feeds.title: I Crashed The Web | Fitness, Cooking and Travel Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to I Crashed The Web! My name is Melissa. I like a lot of things and write about all of them. I mostly blog about running, other health and fitness-related stuff, cooking, baking, traveling, and exploring my newest home, Cleveland.

feeds.title: Even Cleveland
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with articles from Even Cleveland.

feeds.title: Ohio Festivals
feeds.description: I am a one-man festival blogger who has done his best to show you all that Ohio has to offer by means of festivals. This blog is used to record my festival-related adventures to aid potential festival-goers or anyone affiliated with festivals.

feeds.title: Cleveland Appraisal Blog
feeds.description: Cleveland Appraisal Blog is a real estate blog that provides insights and advice on real estate appraisals. The blog covers a range of topics, including tips for home buyers and sellers, market trends, and the latest news and developments in the real estate appraisal industry.

feeds.title: Eat Drink Cleveland
feeds.description: A hungry girl's adventures in Cleveland and beyond featuring places to go, things to eat, great finds, recipes & beauty. Eat! Drink! Explore!

feeds.title: Cleveland Academy of Veterinary Medicine Blog
feeds.description: The Cleveland Academy of Veterinary Medicine is an organization comprised of local Cleveland veterinarians. Our main goal is to provide continuing education (CE) meetings regularly throughout the year for members and staff.

feeds.title: Michelle Jones Photography | Cleveland Photography Blog
feeds.description: Michelle Jones is a Cleveland area photographer specializing in maternity, newborn, baby, and family portraiture.Follow us to know more.

feeds.title: Browns Nation
feeds.description: Your #1 Resource for Cleveland Browns news, updates, rumors, trades, signings, injuries, commentary, analysis, and more!

feeds.title: NEOtrans Blog
feeds.description: NEOtrans blog is dedicated to learning and sharing news about the latest developments in Northeast Ohio's economic transformation. Get breaking news, business, economy, development of Greater Cleveland. Deep analytics and research of Northeast Ohio business opportunities and insights by professional, local journalists.

feeds.title: Greatest Escapist | A Blog about Life in Cleveland
feeds.description: I'm Katie and welcome to the Greatest Escapist. I've been writing here since 2007, so if you have a lot of time on your hands you could find 50 Things I've Done, Testing the Strong Ones, You Can Do It, Put Your Back (Brace) Into It, and much more.

feeds.title: Bite Buff
feeds.description: Welcome to Bite Buff and I am Katrina. Join me as I explore the best (and maybe sometimes the worst) that Cleveland and it's independent restaurants have to offer. Let's take a 'bite' out of our city together, as I make Cleveland my home.

feeds.title: Rainbow Muffler & Brake Blog
feeds.description: Featuring tips on maintaining your car and saving money on auto repairs, the Rainbow Muffler & Brake Blog is your go-to source for automotive knowledge.

feeds.title: The Cleveland Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Cleveland Foundation's mission is to enhance the lives of all residents of Greater Cleveland, now and for generations to come, by working together with our donors to build community endowment, address needs through grantmaking, and provide leadership on key community issues.

feeds.title: The Green Eyed Lady Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Carissa and the creator of The Green Eyed Lady Blog! This blog over the years has evolved from a fashion blog into a parenting/lifestyle blog. I am still a plus size Fashionista at heart but first I am a Wife and Mom!

feeds.title: Courtney Covers Cleveland
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Courtney Lynn Ottrix and I'm a pretty cool millennial wife and mom who was tired of people complaining there's nothing to do in Cleveland! Join me and my iPhone as we prove them wrong, by spotlighting cool people, cool places and cool events in Cleveland. Hope you enjoy!

feeds.title: Cleveland Pain Care Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Adam J. Hedaya M.D. is the founder of Cleveland Pain Care and is a Double Board Certified. He has been in practice for over 10 years. He is an expert in managing both spinal pain and all other pain conditions. Cleveland Pain Care provides individualized treatment programs for acute and chronic pain conditions of the spine and body.

feeds.title: Cleveland Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Medical, health and wellness news, information and insights from Cleveland Clinic's experts, designed to help people make quality decisions about their healthcare. Cleveland Clinic is one of the largest and most respected hospitals in the country. Our mission is to provide better care of the sick, investigation into their problems, and further education of those who serve.

feeds.title: Laubacher & Co. | Cleveland Family Law Blog
feeds.description: Mr. Laubacher is a graduate of the American Bar Association Domestic Relations Litigation Institute. The Cleveland bankruptcy attorneys at Laubacher & Company are committed to helping people to get a fresh financial start.

feeds.title: Why CLE? | Blog about Cleveland
feeds.description: Welcome to Why CLE? I am Jen. This blog is about my journey to find, experience, and share great reasons why you should live, work and play in Cleveland; why you should be proud of our town; why we're one of the best locations in the nation.

feeds.title: The Wardrobe Consultant | Fashion Stylists for Real People
feeds.description: Are you looking for a wardrobe makeover, a fine-tuning, or the head-turning look for a special occasion? Do you have the clothes, but just don't know how to put them together? Look no further, Hallie and her team are here with their blog The Wardrobe Consultant.

feeds.title: CLEfashionista
feeds.description: I'm Rachel, a life-long Clevelander and the face behind CLEfashionista. Here you will find a lot of Cleveland love, fashion, outfit inspiration and a little in between. I hope you find something here that resonates with you, inspires you or makes you want to explore Cleveland.
